A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete, readable 18-page BioAgent Bench paper, including Appendix A.1–A.8. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish matching scientific content; differences are confined to the arXiv version/date stamp and PDF metadata.

before.justification: v2 reports original model evaluations, planning analysis, robustness trials, and perturbation outcomes in Section 6, plus harness results and a trial-log case study in Appendix A.5 and A.7.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in Section 6, Figures 2–3, Tables 2–4, and Appendix A.7.

M1.justification: The evaluation pipeline, agent harness setup, GPT-5.1 grading procedure, and system/task/grader prompts are identical in Sections 4–5 and Appendix A.1–A.4.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same ten bioinformatics tasks listed in Table 1 and Appendix A.3, with identical planning, robustness, and perturbation coverage.

E2.justification: The model and harness participation in Figure 2 and Appendix A.5/Table 4 is unchanged. No comparator is added, removed, or revised within any comparison.

E3.justification: Sections 4–6 and Appendix A.6/A.8 retain identical resource constraints, model settings, completion scoring, robustness calculations, and task-specific perturbation procedures.

E4.justification: The planning analysis, repeated-trial robustness, perturbation and failure analyses, and Salmon configuration case study are unchanged in Figure 3, Tables 2–3, Section 6.2, and Appendix A.7.

E5.justification: Trial counts in Section 6.1/Table 2, single-trial perturbation reporting in Section 6.2, and the uncertainty limitations in Section 8 are identical. No seed or statistical-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative findings match, including the appendix results. For example, Claude Opus 4.5 retains 100% completion with Codex CLI in Table 4, and Figure 3 retains the planning–completion correlation of r = 0.61.

T1.justification: The Jaccard formula and correlation calculations in Section 6.1 are unchanged. Neither version contains additional theoretical results or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical contributions and claims about the benchmark, model comparisons, high pipeline completion, and brittle step-level reliability.

C2.justification: Sections 7–8 and Appendix A.7 retain the same interpretations of agentic competence and run variability, privacy-related applicability, and limitations concerning grading, resource constraints, and robustness sampling.

D1.justification: The prompts, data descriptions, robustness calculation details, Salmon flags, and perturbation construction instructions in Appendix A.1–A.8 are identical. The dataset and evaluation-suite repository links are also unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the citations, and the reference list are identical, including the positioning relative to SWE-bench, BioML-bench, LAB-Bench, and BixBench.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 8 March 2026 to v3 dated 7 May 2026. This is a limited administrative text update; manuscript wording, terminology, and section organization are identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–3, Tables 1–5, the unnumbered prompt-bloat table, captions, and manuscript layout are unchanged. Rendered pages match outside the first-page arXiv stamp.

improvement.justification: v3 preserves v2's scientific text, empirical evidence, technical appendices, and visual presentation. The version/date and metadata updates produce no meaningful difference in clarity, evidential strength, or reproducibility.
